$comment: Hand-maintained list of the non-npm (native) components LOAM's builds ship, appended to THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs. `builds` names the presets an entry belongs to (cli, desktop, android). `version` is either fixed, or `versionFrom` reads it from an installed package ({ dir, package }, resolved from that workspace dir). `licenseFrom` reads the licence text from an installed package's file; `licenseText` is the text used when that file can't be found, or when there is none to read. Check apps/app/native-prebuilds/*/README.md, docs/04, docs/14 and docs/24 when changing anything here.

components.name: Electron
components.note: The desktop app's runtime (Chromium and Node.js). Chromium and the libraries it bundles are under their own licences, listed in the LICENSES.chromium.html file inside every Electron release download (https://github.com/electron/electron/releases); the Windows and Linux installs also carry it in the app's folder, beside Electron's LICENSE.electron.txt.

components.name: nodejs-mobile (Node.js for Android)
components.note: The Node.js runtime (libnode) that runs LOAM's server inside the Android app, shipped by @comapeo/nodejs-mobile-react-native (listed above with its own licence). Node.js also bundles externally maintained libraries (V8, libuv, OpenSSL, ICU, zlib, llhttp and others) under their own licences; the complete list and texts for this version are in https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v18.20.4/LICENSE.

components.name: better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers
components.note: The encrypted SQLite driver. The desktop app ships it in dist/main/node_modules; loamnet installs it from npm as an optional dependency, only for --encrypt. It compiles in SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers and SQLite (see below).

components.name: better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers Android prebuild (built by LOAM)
components.note: The encrypted SQLite driver's native binary, cross-compiled from the unmodified 12.11.1 sources by apps/app/native-prebuilds/multiple-ciphers/build-mc-android-arm64.sh. It compiles in SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers and SQLite (see below). Its JavaScript side is the better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers package listed above, under the same licence.

components.name: SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers
